comparisonGuide: Reference interpretations: A is consistent with interphase. B is the source prophase example, but condensation alone may not distinguish late prophase, prometaphase or an oblique aligned view. C shows the central alignment expected at metaphase. D shows the separated chromosome groups expected at anaphase. E is the source late-division/telophase example; the image does not clearly resolve nuclear-envelope reformation. Accept a qualified stage interpretation supported by visible features and a stated uncertainty. A diagram cannot supply a feature absent from the photograph.
